diff_summary: Replaced both JADE-FLAG:BUILD_RMIC_DEPRECATED marker comments in the jade target with JADE-MODERNIZATION-DEFERRED:BUILD_RMIC_DEPRECATED comments; the two <rmic> elements themselves are untouched (rmic still works on JDK 8, only deprecated). Real `ant clean jade` run under frekele/ant:1.10.3-jdk8 (JDK8) confirms BUILD SUCCESSFUL, exit 0, both expected JRMP-stub-deprecation warnings present, and both generated stub classes present on disk (jade/imtp/rmi/ServiceManagerRMIImpl_Stub.class, jade/imtp/rmi/NodeRMIImpl_Stub.class). The wired verify_shard.py step failed (exit 2) for a reason unrelated to the fix: it always invokes javac against the shard's editable_files, and this shard's only editable_file is build.xml (not a .java source), so javac rejected it with 'invalid flag: /ws/src/jade/build.xml'. That is the same structural verify_shard.py limitation already hit and documented on the BUILD_DOCLINT_STRICT shard (no Ant verification path exists for BUILD_* rules), not a defect in this edit.
